additional_info.subject: 0473696 - ID0473696-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R8 170002544] Meter Value Mismatch Between Consecutive OCPP Transactions CRM:00472000528
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for contacting us and for bringing the discrepancy in the OCPP transaction energy readings to our attention. We have thoroughly analyzed the situation you described, where the final energy reading of one session does not match the initial reading of the subsequent session.
We have identified that this issue occurs due to a fault in our Communication Controller (SECC), which, under certain circumstances, may stop responding. When this happens, the system processes a "StopTransaction" even though, inadvertently the charging session continues. This situation leads to the inconsistency you observed in the records.
I would like to inform you that our R&D team has already been notified about this bug and is actively working on a solution. Resolving this matter as quickly as possible is a high priority for us. However, at this moment, we do not yet have an exact timeline for when a fix will be available.
As this is an issue that requires a development-level correction and cannot be resolved through service actions or technical support, we will proceed with closing this ticket. Nevertheless, I want to assure you that the topic will remain under active treatment by the R&D team until a definitive solution is implemented.
We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to resolve this matter. Should you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
